text_to_speech: foreign I work as a section manager at the IT department at the University of Oslo and I'm Francis Augusta medelus I work as an I.T engineer at the I.T Department of the University Hospital we've set up next Cloud as a way for our users to share and collaborate on data and text files as part of a on-prem research platform that we have set up at the University so we basically saw a need for our researchers to have an easy way to share files share data in a secure way but to allow them to do that for themselves without the need to email files around or upload their files to commercial Cloud providers from a technical perspective what I love about netscloud is their ability to to provide the solutions that users need if they want a calendar you can give them a calendar if they want the communications to we can expand it and at the same time have the full control so it's not a sealed package that we cannot you know do anything about it primarily we've set it up for researchers but we do see now that it's also probably quite a good tool as well for at least our older students like Masters students a way for them to also be able to not just work with their University supervisors but maybe if they have external supervisors from industry to have a way that they can collaborate without the need for the external parties to have University accounts thank you

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Anna Baleksegd, I work as a section manager at the IT department at the University of Oslo.
And I'm Francis Augusto Medeiros, I work as an IT engineer at the IT department of the University of Oslo.
We set up next cloud as a way for our users to share and collaborate on data and text files,
as part of an on-prem research platform that we have set up at the University.
So we basically saw a need for our researchers to have an easy way to share files, share data in a secure way,
but to allow them to do that themselves without the need to email files around or upload their files to commercial cloud providers.
From a technical perspective, what I love about next cloud is the ability to provide the solutions that users need.
If they want a calendar, they can give them a calendar. If they want the communications to, we can expand it.
And at the same time, we have the full control. So it's not a sealed package that we cannot do anything about it.
Primarily, we've set it up for researchers, but we do see now that it's also probably quite a good tool as well for these older students,
like master students, a way for them to also be able to not just work with their university supervisors,
but maybe if they have external supervisors from industry to have a way that they can collaborate without the need for the external parties to have university accounts.

youtube_description:
Interview with Francis Augusto Medeiros-Logeay and Anne S. Bergsaker from the University of Oslo during Nextcloud's Enterprise Day in 2023.

The University of Oslo uses Nextcloud's flexibility as a solution to ensure their researchers can share data privately, efficiently, and confidently in one collaborative platform.

At Nextcloud we offer a modular approach to our features that allows the University of Oslo to create custom, on-premises solutions that meet their collaboration needs of sharing data while keeping it under their control.

Discover what Nextcloud can do for your university or organization:
https://nextcloud.com/
